# A prerequisite already found up to date must not be checked again: -e
# reports it once, and a P program runs once per prerequisite.
mk -e -p 1 -f mkfile b
stderr 'mk: b is up to date'
! stderr '(?s)b is up to date.*b is up to date'

mk -p 1 -f mkfile out
exec cat calls.log
stdout -count=1 'out in'

-- mkfile --
b:
	touch b

out:Psh count.sh: in
	cp in out
-- b --
-- in --
-- out --
-- count.sh --
#!/bin/sh
echo "$@" >> calls.log
exit 0
